name: ai-relay-gateway
description: Multi-provider, multi-key AI relay gateway with automatic key rotation and provider failover. Runs free on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.deploy: npm run build:ui && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the gateway admin dashboard.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Secret used to encrypt upstream API keys at rest (any long random string, e.g. `openssl rand -base64 32`).

SESSION_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign dashboard session cookies (any long random string).
